After steaming, the translucent rolls reveal pink cooked shrimp and green onion inside; she pours the dark savory sauce over them. She tastes the finished rolls with chopsticks, reacting with visible enjoyment and describing the result as 'like a 10 out of 10.' The tone is instructional, friendly, and appetizing, focused entirely on the cooking process and final taste test.
